items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: Basie and this guy, O'Taylor, used to play there.

ctx.x: E-b-l-o-n. Eblon. And you remember in the previous years, Basie and this guy, O'Taylor, used to play there. They played this accompanying music while the silent movie, or something, was showing. And Basie played the organ and this guy played the violin.
Well, what happened to the -- I mean, when it became the Cherry Blossom? Was it a dance hall then, or --
